Hi Laura — thanks for sending these over and for the quick turnaround. A couple of next steps from our side to get you fully activated in Finance: 

1) Please confirm you uploaded the signed vendor onboarding form to the Redwood vendor portal (preferred). If not, I've linked the direct upload here: https://app.redwood.com/vendor/onboarding/verify?token=xyz-verify

2) Finance (cc'd: Priyom) will perform micro-deposit verification to the account ending 4321. Expect two small deposits within 48 hours — please reply to this thread with the amounts to confirm.

3) We require either a voided check or a bank letter on company letterhead (you attached both — great). Also please provide a copy of your W-9 if you haven't already (you can attach it in reply).

4) Remit formatting: our AP system auto-matches on the following preferred string in the invoice remittance field: "PO:{PO_NUMBER}|INV:{INVOICE_NUMBER}|V:{VENDOR_NAME}". Example: "PO:2028-BS-00987|INV:INV-3220|V:BlueSparc Inc". If you include that exact pattern on invoices we will not need manual reconciliation in most cases. If you plan to send a consolidated monthly invoice, please flag it as "CONSOLIDATED-MONTHLY" in the invoice number field and include the PO reference.

Priyom — can you start the micro-deposit to the account ending 4321 and create an initial PO we can reference? Marissa, looping you for any procurement checklist items we should confirm.
